text:
Ah, Floralva! I dreamed that you... shall I say? Yes: I enjoyed you. Who but a dreaming lover joins hell to heaven?


Love mingled my flames with your snow and ice, like opposing arrows, chastely.


I said: may I never sleep if awake, and if asleep never wake.


But I woke, and saw I lived with death and with life was dead.

translation.title: A Lover Grateful for a Dream's Lying Flattery
